source: pandapower.shortcircuit.calc_sc, IEC 60909 equivalent voltage source method
source_note: Reference fixture: ideal 20 kV external grid, one 1 km line section R=0.2 ohm/km, X=0.4 ohm/km, fault='3ph', case='max', c=1.10, tk_s=1.0. Values match the closed-form IEC 60909 equivalent-voltage-source calculation: Z_k=(0.2+j0.4) ohm, |Z_k|=0.4472135955 ohm, Ik''=c*U_n/(sqrt(3)*|Z_k|)=28.401877872 kA. The fixture is intentionally minimal so that the proof can show every step and can be regenerated with pandapower when the optional dependency is installed.
